title: Building Great Software
abstract: An overview of modern software engineering best practices, from architecture to deployment. Learn how to build maintainable, scalable applications that stand the test of time.
description: In this talk we will explore test-driven development, continuous integration, and clean architecture patterns that help teams deliver quality software consistently.

speakers.name: Bob Smith
speakers.biography: Bob is a QA architect who has been writing automated tests since before it was cool. He runs the testing guild at a major tech company.

title: Introduction to Testing
abstract: A beginner-friendly introduction to software testing: unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests. We will cover the testing pyramid and practical strategies for getting started.
